🗺 Life Map

8 Days

Three patterns, all pulling from the same numerology this app already uses: an 8-day (the 8th, 17th or 26th of any month), the 28th — a sub-master day of its own, and a date whose full digits reduce to a Universal Day of 8. Every one of these is a real shopping-day trigger.

All Events

Everything you log lives in this browser only — keep a backup file somewhere safe.
📅 Auto-fill from Google Calendar. On a computer, open Google Calendar → Settings → Import & export → Export, unzip the download, then bring the .ics file in here. Clinic bookings and personal events populate themselves; re-importing updates matched events instead of duplicating them.

🔔 Notifications

Reminders for events, your fasting timer and the commute — set once here, they re-arm themselves whenever your book changes. Works best with Book33 added to your home screen.
